sources.name: axil_crossbar_wr.v
sources.use: Architectural comparison of mature separated read/write AXI-Lite fabric and round-robin arbitration. Independently written narrow RTL; no third-party source copied. This small core allows one outstanding transaction per upstream direction rather than matching all reference features.
